completed_families: common rational factors depending only on the analytic-parallel parameter
common rational factors depending only on the rational-Bezier parameter
simultaneous factors in both parameter directions
closed-domain rootlessness proofs under STRICT and APPROXIMATE_512

mathematical_contract.extraction: Hypersolve computes exact rational polynomial GCD content shared by both equations first by columns and then by rows, and divides both equations exactly
mathematical_contract.authorization: Hypercurve uses a reduced system only after isolating every root of every nonconstant removed factor and proving that none lies on the closed authored interval [0,1]
mathematical_contract.domain_preservation: rootless axis saturation preserves the complete solution set on the closed parameter square; factors with endpoint or interior roots are not removed
mathematical_contract.projective_base_points: an in-domain removable homogeneous base point remains an explicit Boundary uncertainty rather than being silently regularized away
mathematical_contract.coefficient_domain: this cut accepts only Hypersolve's exact rational factor report; unsupported Real coefficient towers remain on the existing degenerate/incomplete boundary
mathematical_contract.strict: STRICT accepts only exact factor arithmetic and exact closed-domain rootlessness certificates
mathematical_contract.approximate_512: APPROXIMATE_512 follows the same proof graph and may differ only when inherited Hyperreal decisions terminate at the authorized 512-bit equality boundary
mathematical_contract.cache_isolation: an approximate-only PH classification is not retained as a certified rational parallel and cannot answer a later STRICT query
mathematical_contract.replay: candidate construction retains the exact original or reduced bivariate equations, so contact replay does not reconstruct a different system or repeat equation construction

implementation.hypersolve_api: extract_bivariate_polynomial_system_axis_factors returns explicit Primitive, Reduced, ZeroSystem, UnsupportedCoefficient, or DivisionFailed status plus the two axis factors and optional reduced equations
implementation.hypercurve_spine: BezierParallel2::intersection_candidate_system owns bounds, projections, rational-component delegation, axis saturation, and retained replay equations behind the unchanged public candidate result
implementation.projection: one project_parallel_intersection_system helper preserves first-projection degenerate short-circuiting and is reused after saturation
implementation.rational_component_order: zero-distance and certified PH parallels delegate to RationalBezier2 before axis saturation, preserving the existing authoritative overlap engine and its oriented range evidence
implementation.allocation_control: primitive factor reports avoid cloning equation systems; reduced equations are retained only when finite candidates require replay
implementation.tests: source-axis and target-axis rootless homogeneous factors produce two exact contacts under both policies; an in-domain projective base point remains Boundary; a direct unit matrix proves that every removed factor must be rootless

matched_release_benchmark.method: five interleaved all-feature release processes pinned to CPU 11 with identical benchmark source and fixtures; CPU 9 was occupied by an unrelated Hypermesh session and was neither used nor interrupted
matched_release_benchmark.baseline_semantics: each new rootless-axis lane returns DegenerateResultant with checksum 10; the candidate returns four exact projected parameters with checksum 40 and two exact contacts with checksum 20

rootless_source_axis_candidates.interpretation: accepted completeness cost: four exact projected parameters replace one unresolved marker

rootless_source_axis_contacts.interpretation: accepted completeness cost: two exactly replayed selected-branch contacts replace one unresolved marker

rootless_target_axis_candidates.interpretation: accepted completeness cost: four exact projected parameters replace one unresolved marker

rootless_target_axis_contacts.interpretation: accepted completeness cost: two exactly replayed selected-branch contacts replace one unresolved marker

warm_ph_overlap_candidates.interpretation: ten-iteration sub-two-microsecond lane; retained as a noisy size-of-effect sentinel

ordinary_sentinels.interpretation: all ordinary exact/algebraic candidate and contact medians remain within 0.63 percent on the sole regressing lane; five of eight lanes improve

matched_heaptrack.method: the identical complete release benchmark process under Heaptrack on CPU 11; candidate and control include the same added rootless-axis fixtures
matched_heaptrack.interpretation: peak heap is unchanged; profiler-wide call growth includes the newly completed rootless lanes doing four-result projection and two-contact replay where the baseline stopped at one unresolved marker

matched_offset_microbenchmark.interpretation: the source fixture is byte-identical across both builds, so the delta represents linked implementation and Hypersolve support rather than benchmark-only fixture skew

static_call_graph.caveat: the utility is a static source approximation; the matched graphs exclude tests and benchmarks, and the exact-stack scan deliberately excludes Hypermesh

competitive_context.reason: available offset libraries do not expose exact projective-base-point semantics, complete two-parameter correspondence, selected-normal replay, or STRICT/APPROXIMATE_512 evidence
competitive_context.comparison_rule: an unresolved historical result and heuristic finite offset output are not reported as correctness-equivalent throughput
